sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet for 2-sheet drawing set. Project title: 'Prosperity Eating Disorders and Wellness Center, ICC Building 7 - 1st Floor, Norfolk, VA.' Scope descriptor reads 'Tenant Improvements for Prosperity Eating Disorders and Wellness Center.' Drawing index lists only G-001 (cover) and ME101 (new work plan). Issue date 2/3/2022. Title block shows 'CHA PROJECT' in the project number field — suggests this was issued for a Construction/CA phase service rather than a full design commission. Engineer seal: Romdhya Kumar, VA License 0402465820, dated 02/03/2022. BFA firm identified as 'BOWMAN FOSTER & ASSOCIATES, INC.' with Hampton Roads address. Vicinity map shows project location in Virginia Beach / Norfolk area near Camp Pendleton and Dam Neck FTC — vicinity map marker is labeled 'PROJECT LOCATION' at Virginia Beach, though title block states Norfolk, VA — minor geographic ambiguity (could be Virginia Beach address with Norfolk jurisdiction, or vice versa).

sheets.title: ICC BUILDING 7 RANGE HOOD INSTALLATION — NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Single combined mechanical/electrical sheet at 1/4"=1'-0" scale. Floor plan shows Demo Kitchen (room 115), Dining Room (116), Pantry (114), and RR (113) on the 1st floor of ICC Building 7. Scope is narrow: install one Greenheck fire-ready range hood (Model GRR5, 30" wide unit, self-contained fire suppression system, NFPA 101 compliant, minimum 500 CFM) in the demo kitchen. Exhaust system: 12" diameter duct routed through cabinets and exterior wall with spun aluminum vent, wall cap, backdraft damper, and bird screen. Range hood wall cap detail shown (no scale) at upper right. Electrical scope: provide NEMA 5-15R receptacle for range control panel (115V, 1A); one existing NEMA 14-50R receptacle for the new range hood (one existing NEMA 14-50R also serves existing range — relocation may be required); add 15A/1P circuit breaker at space 22 of Existing Panel '2' to serve new range control circuit. Panel '1' and Panel '2' to remain. Panel '2' schedule shown: 225A, 208/120V, 3-phase, 3-wire, surface mount. Fire alarm: provide pull station connected to hood per manufacturer's instructions. Construction notes 1-8 visible and legible. Note 8: 'Existing electrical room located in the corridor of Building 7.' Manufacturer reference: Square D, Type NQOB, Cat. #NQ0B-19128-2C1 for panelboard. This is a very small-scope tenant improvement — effectively a single appliance installation with associated exhaust and electrical rough-in.

gross_square_footage.note: No area schedule or code summary provided. Project scope is limited to Demo Kitchen room 115 and associated exhaust penetration. Room dimensions not dimensioned on plan.

floor_count.note: Scope limited to 1st floor of ICC Building 7. Number of floors in the building overall is unknown from these drawings.
